question: Use `tests/qa/testcase.py`, class `TestTemplateGetDirectivesOuterLoopTotalIterationsQA`. The class contains 15 test methods (`test_template_get_directives_outer_loop_total_iterations_case_01` through `..._case_15`). Each test method instantiates `cfnlint.template.Template("foo.yaml", template, ["us-east-1"])` (one or more times) with templates of varying `Resources` shape, then calls `cfn.get_directives()` on each. The templates mix four kinds of `Resources` entries: (i)  fully-valid (dict with `Type`, `Properties`, and `Metadata.cfn-lint.config.ignore_checks` lists); (ii) dict-valued but WITHOUT a `Type` field; (iii) NON-dict values (e.g. a string); (iv) dict-valued with `Type: None`. QUESTION: how many times does the for-loop at line 336 of `src/cfnlint/template/template.py` (`for resource_name, resource_values in resources.items():` inside `Template.get_directives`) iterate its BODY during ONE such test method's execution? (The answer is invariant -- every one of the 15 test methods produces the same iteration count.) Return the answer under the field `total_iterations`. Reasoning rules to simulate (PER TEST): (a) The line-336 loop iterates over `resources` where `resources = self.get_resources()` (line 334). `get_resources()` (lines 180-206) does NOT return the raw `template["Resources"]`; it pre-filters to include ONLY entries `(k, v)` where `isinstance(v, dict)` AND `v.get("Type") is not None`. So entries (ii), (iii), and (iv) above are SILENTLY DROPPED before the loop ever sees them. (b) If `template["Resources"]` is missing or non-dict, `get_resources()` returns `{}`. The `if resources:` guard at line 335 then skips the for-loop entirely -- the call contributes 0 iterations. (c) The inner for-loop at line 344 (`for ignore_rule_id in ignore_rule_ids:`) is a DECOY: it iterates over `Metadata.cfn-lint.config.ignore_checks` lists. The QUESTION targets the OUTER loop at line 336 ONLY -- inner-loop iterations DO NOT count. (d) Within the loop, `if isinstance(resource_values, dict)` at line 337 is ALWAYS true (the pre-filter guarantees this), so every iteration enters the body fully -- there is no `continue` short-circuit at the outer level. (e) Multiple `cfn.get_directives()` invocations in the same test method ADD their iter counts. (f) The total per test is the SUM over all calls of `len(self.get_resources())`, where each `self.get_resources()` evaluates the dict + has-Type filter on that call's specific `template["Resources"]`.
